title: Skill
description: Schema for a compendium Skill entry (Rpg/Compendium/Skills/Skill.cs + SkillExpressions.cs). The compendium file should be a JSON object whose keys are skill IDs.

ArgumentSlot.description: A single argument slot: either one type string or an array of accepted types (the player can provide any of them).

DamageBlock.description: Describes the damage dealt by an attack skill.

type.description: DamageType compendium ID (may be a string literal or expression).

description.description: Human-readable reason shown when the attack misses.

Skill.description: A skill compendium entry. 'type' determines which subclass is instantiated.

type.description: 'arbitrary' for a general-purpose skill; 'attack' for an ArbitraryAttackSkill.

execute.description: Effect evaluated on each execution tick.

start.description: Effect evaluated when the skill starts.

cancel.description: Effect evaluated when the skill is cancelled. Variables: [$0 = interrupted (bool)].

canCancel.description: Whether the skill can be cancelled by the user.

canExecute.description: Whether the skill can be used at all (CanBeUsed check, evaluated on caller entity only).

condition.description: Arbitrary condition available for use in other expressions.

canTarget.description: Whether a given target is a valid target for this skill.

delay.description: Tick delay before the skill executes after being used.

cooldown.description: Tick cooldown after the skill finishes.

duration.description: How many ticks the skill's execution lasts. Defaults to 1.

layers.description: Skill layer identifiers that control visibility and grouping. Defaults to ['default'].

arguments.description: Ordered list of argument slots. Each slot is a type string or an array of accepted types.

damage.description: Damage definition. Only meaningful for 'attack' type skills.

doesHit.description: Hit condition and miss reason. Only meaningful for 'attack' type skills.

onHit.description: Effect evaluated when the attack hits. Only meaningful for 'attack' type skills.

onAttack.description: Effect evaluated when the attack resolves (hit or miss). Only meaningful for 'attack' type skills.
